description: This file defines a PHP interface named HelpProcessor within the OrangeHRM project's Help namespace. The interface specifies methods related to obtaining URLs for help content, including base URL, search URL, and redirect URL.

classes.name: HelpProcessor
classes.description: A PHP interface for help processing functionality within the OrangeHRM Help module, specifying methods for retrieving various URLs related to help content.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for help content.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Returns a search URL for a given help label.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns a redirect URL for a specified help label.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the default redirect URL for help content.
